summary: Narrow residential street ending at a T; houses 2-7 m from kerb.

best_section.where: West kerb at the south end of this Fairley Street stub

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes at 2 m (at 2 m) and 6 m (at 13 m) on the section's side, houses all round.

drivers.traffic: Quiet side street, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Residents' cars park here; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Street trees shade the east side; houses and trees shade the west kerb.
